name: Gallery by paint
description: Pushes one picture_gallery photo per panel wake (timer or button). The panel reports paint_seq, painted_digest and wake_reason in its heartbeat; the plugin advances on every wake.

settings.name: device_id
settings.label: Device id
settings.help: The panel whose paint confirmations drive the lineup.

settings.name: page_id
settings.label: Gallery page id
settings.help: The dashboard page containing the picture_gallery cell.

settings.name: folder
settings.label: Gallery folder
settings.help: Internal gallery folder to rotate. External folders are read-only.
